verdict.rationale: The only user-configurable recurring schedule in the evidence is recurring invoices at a chosen frequency, which is a narrow, single-purpose schedule rather than general recurring jobs or workflows. Continuous auto-reconciliation is always-on behavior, not a schedule the user sets, and Command tasks are one-off handoffs. The API and MCP layer are announced for the future only. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows, recurring schedules for Command or AI-agent tasks, recurring scheduled reports, a shipped API or MCP surface for scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Make it recurring in a few clicks and at your chosen frequency.
